narrative.overview:
FundStats looks like a market data terminal: near-black, square, monospace and dense. Every screen is a full-width data surface first. Chrome is thin hairline rules and small uppercase labels, so the numbers carry the page. Amber is the single voice of the interface (selection, focus, the active source, the sorted column); green and red belong only to price movement.

Space is spent on data. There are no docked sidebars, no empty gutters beside the table and no decorative cards. Navigation lives in a drawer behind the menu button, closed by default, and the table runs edge to edge. Highlighted numbers change colour or weight, never position, so columns stay aligned.

The system is dark only, by design.
keyCharacteristics: One monospace family 11px at the smallest, tabular figures everywhere.
Square corners on every element; hairline 1px rules instead of shadows for structure.
Amber for interface state, green and red only for gains and losses.
Full-width table; navigation in a drawer, never a docked column.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Amber marks interface state and nothing else. If two amber things compete on screen, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Money Colour Rule
rules.body: Green and red mean up and down. Never use them for status, success, error or decoration.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: No text is smaller than 11px, labels included; running text is at least 12px.

rules.name: The Aligned Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number uses tabular figures and right alignment. Emphasis changes colour or weight only, so a highlighted value never shifts its column.

rules.name: The No Gutter Rule
rules.body: The table spans the full width. Don't add sidebars, empty columns or centred max-width containers beside it. Inside it, spare width is spread over the figure columns; the name column stops at its longest name (at most 44ch), so no single gap opens after the names.

rules.name: The Floating Option
rules.body: The viewer can switch the table to a floating panel (LAYOUT in the table settings): an inset of 32px × 24px on Void with a Strong Hairline border, on screens 1024px and up. It is a frame around the full-width table, not a narrower one.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this is above the table". Nothing resting on the page carries one.

dos: Do use Terminal Amber for exactly one meaning: interface state (active, selected, sorted, focused).
Do right-align numbers with tabular figures and signal direction with Gain Green and Loss Red only.
Do give the table the full width and move navigation into the drawer.
Do keep labels at 11px uppercase with letter spacing, in Dim Label; never smaller.
donts: Don't dock a sidebar or leave empty space beside the table.
Don't shift a number's position to highlight it; change colour or weight instead.
Don't use green or red for anything except price movement.
Don't introduce a second font family or rounded corners.
Don't put shadows on elements that rest on the page.
